chunks: Verily We gave Moses the Book; so be not in doubt about his having received it; and We made it a guidance for the children of Israel.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Book given to Moses in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Surah As-Sajdah, this verse reaffirms the divine origin of the Torah given to Musa (AS) as a primary source of guidance for Bani Israel, serving as a precursor to the Quran. Shia exegesis often highlights this as part of the continuum of prophetic revelation, where the 'Kitab' is not merely a book but a comprehensive guide that establishes the legitimacy of Moses' mission and his eventual meeting with Allah. It underscores the consistency of divine instruction across eras, reinforcing faith in the continuity of prophethood.
